note: v2 (owner, 2026-11-17): characters speak on camera (lip-sync), almost no narrator, voices placed in the scene.

emma.ref: My name is Emma. I live alone now, in the house we bought together. Some nights I still hear his footsteps on the stairs, and I wonder if I am losing my mind.

mark.ref: I am Mark, Daniel's older brother. I have always looked after this family. Whatever happens, I make sure everything stays exactly the way it should be.

operator.ref: We are sorry. The number you have dialed is not in service. Please check the number and try again.

narrator.ref: Some messages should never be answered. This is the story of one of them, and of the night it arrived.

looks.emma: a 32-year-old woman with long straight auburn hair, pale skin with light freckles and green eyes, wearing a grey knit cardigan over a black top
looks.mark: a tall 42-year-old man with short black hair and a short trimmed black beard, sharp jaw, wearing a long black wool overcoat

style: Cinematic thriller film shot, night, dark moody low-key lighting, deep shadows, realistic, 35mm film

shots.v: A dark bedroom at night. {emma} is asleep in bed. On the nightstand a smartphone suddenly lights up and glows brightly, lighting the room. Static camera.
shots.label: 3:07 AM

shots.v: Close-up of {emma} lying in bed in a dark bedroom, she wakes up and slowly reaches for her glowing phone, the screen light on her sleepy face. Slow push-in.

Close-up of {emma} sitting up in bed in a dark bedroom, looking at her phone in shock, then looking up and speaking to herself in a trembling voice, her lips moving, phone light on her face. Static camera.
lines: Daniel? No... no. You're dead. This isn't possible.
The number you have dialed is not in service.

shots.v: Flashback. A funeral in heavy rain at a grey cemetery. {mark} and other men in black carry a wooden coffin slowly, his face grim. Slow tracking shot.
shots.label: ONE YEAR AGO

shots.v: Flashback. At a rainy cemetery under a black umbrella, {mark} holds the shoulders of a crying woman and looks into her eyes, speaking to her softly, his lips moving, his face toward the camera. Slow push-in.
lines: I'm here now, Emma. Whatever you need. Always.

msgs: Check his laptop. Before he does.

shots.v: {emma} walks slowly down a dark wooden staircase at night holding her phone flashlight, looking around nervously. Camera follows her.
In a dark home office at night {emma} sits at a desk in front of an open laptop, the bright screen lighting her tense face, she whispers to herself, her lips moving. Static close-up.
lines: His password... still our wedding date.

shots.v: In a dark home office {emma} looks up startled as the lights suddenly go out, the room drops into darkness, only the laptop glow on her frightened face.
A dark house hallway at night seen from the far end, the front door at the end of the hall, a thin line of warm light under the door. Very slow push-in. No people.
shots.label: 3:21 AM

shots.v: {emma} creeps slowly along a dark hallway toward the front door holding her phone light, terrified, breathing fast. Camera follows behind her.

Night, a front porch under a single dim porch light. {mark} faces the camera and speaks calmly toward the closed door, his lips moving, a cold smile, then he raises a single house key. Static medium shot.
lines: Emma? I saw your light. Open up. It's just me.

shots.v: Medium close-up of {emma} standing with her back against the inside of the front door in a dark hallway, her face fully lit by her phone light from below, facing the camera, eyes wide with fear, whispering, her lips moving. Static camera.
lines: I never gave you a key.

shots.v: Extreme close-up of a door lock at night, a metal key slides into the keyhole from outside and slowly turns, the door handle starts to move. Dark, moody.

msgs: Check his laptop. Before he does.

shots.v: Inside a dark hallway, the front door slowly creaks open, warm light spills in and a tall dark silhouette of a man stands in the doorway, {emma} backs away into the darkness.
